title: Got a cake screenshot? Mays Hill and South Granville, send it to Harris Park
summary:
Saw a cake on Instagram and want that one? Send us the screenshot. Mays Hill and South Granville families do it every week.

A screenshot on WhatsApp is the clearest brief there is. It shows the colours, the piping and the topper in one picture, which is why our Harris Park team asks for one first. We read the design, tell you what size and finish suit it, and bake it fresh to order. 100% eggless, every layer, so nobody at the table has to ask.

Two days' notice. Order on a Saturday, collect on Monday. Prices start at $39.99 for a 6-inch that serves 6 to 8; design detail sets the final quote.

Pickup only, from Wigram Street, open until 10pm daily. WhatsApp the picture to +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
